The native update repeated without drift and the strict check passes; the instance reports the engine it runs.

Two paths: the machinery manifest stamp and the adoption spec.
The global CLI ran only after the v6.1.0 archive digest and Sigstore identity matched the verified ledger and the binary equalled the independent rebuild; no policy or trust setting changed.
